photo.title: Add a photo for your preview
photo.subtitleResearching: See an AI preview of what a change could look like, before you commit to anything.
photo.subtitlePlanned: See an AI preview of what your operation could look like.
photo.subtitleDone: See an AI preview of what your result could look like as it matures.

angle.front: Face the camera straight on, with the phone at eye level.
angle.top: Hold the phone above your head, looking down at the top of your head.
angle.crown: Photograph the back of your head, ideally with someone's help.

area.hairline: Pull your hair back so the hairline is clear.
area.crown: Keep the crown uncovered and your hair flat.
area.part: Part your hair the way you normally wear it.
area.brows: Keep your brows clear of hair and glasses.
area.beard: Keep the beard area uncovered and in even light.

photo.light: Use daylight, no filters and no hat.
photo.privacy: Your photo is only sent to create the preview, and only after you agree on the next screen.
photo.skipNote: You can create one later from the Previews tab.
photo.permissionDenied: We could not open your photos. Check the permission in Settings.

notify.title: Never miss the moments that matter
notify.subtitle: Recovery is slow. A gentle nudge at the right moment does the remembering for you.
notify.bulletPhase: We will tell you when a phase changes
notify.bulletPhoto: We will tell you when photo day comes
notify.bulletCare: Daily care reminders for the first two weeks
notify.note: Care reminders are free. Phase and photo reminders come with Pro. You can change this any time in Settings.

crafting.title: Creating your preview

crafting.failedTitle: We could not finish your preview

crafting.failedBlocked: This photo cannot be used for a preview. Nothing was charged. You can continue and try another photo later.
